name: descargador
description: Descarga video y audio para edición, 100% local, sin anuncios ni cuentas.
author: Descargador

scripts.build:win:x64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=win --arch=x64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:win:arm64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=win --arch=arm64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:mac:arm64 && npm run build:mac:x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=mac --arch=arm64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=mac --arch=x64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux:x64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=linux --arch=x64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux:arm64: node scripts/fetch-binaries.mjs --platform=linux --arch=arm64 && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
